yǐhòu.meaning: after; in the future (X yǐhòu = after X)

bǎ.meaning: takes a specific object before the verb + result, bǎ X zuò wán

shì bu shì.meaning: is it the case that…? no ma

tígāo.meaning: to raise, to improve; tí = lift, gāo = high

yòu.meaning: again (already happened, + le; future again: zài)

háishi.meaning: still (wǒ háishi hěn lèi = I'm still tired)

lǎobǎn.meaning: boss (dāng lǎobǎn = be the boss; dǎgōng = work for someone)

gěi.meaning: give / for someone (gěi + person + verb), to (gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà), show (gěi wǒ kàn kan)

nǔlì.meaning: try hard (wǒ zài nǔlì + verb; quick try: shìshi)

hái méi.meaning: haven't yet (méi = didn't; bù = don't/won't by choice)

tīngdǒng.meaning: understand by listening, catch (wǒ méi tīngdǒng = I didn't catch that)

bǎo.meaning: full (wǒ bǎo le = I'm full; can't eat more: chī bú xià)

zài.meaning: again, more (before the verb: zài chī, zài shuō)

xiǎng xiang.meaning: think it over (wǒ zài xiǎng xiang = let me think more)

xíguàn.meaning: habit (noun) / be used to (verb); adapting: shìyìng

zǎo qǐ.meaning: get up early (yí ge hǎo xíguàn = a good habit)

jiānchí.meaning: keep at it, persist (jiān = firm + chí = hold)

Nǐ juéde ne? / zěnme yàng.meaning: What do you think? / how about it

tíqián mài chū.meaning: sell early (tí = lift, qián = before; mài = sell, chū = out)
